Context: 13·. Subletting,

- (3) Damages for subletting: Telescopic method will be made applicable for unauthorized occupation in proved subletting cases with effect from 1-7-2016 on all unauthorized occupants as on 1-7-2016 and who will be declared unauthorized henceforth.
